title: On the Seidel energy of uniform hypergraphs due to hyperedge and vertex deletion
summary: Let $\mathcal{S}(\mathcal{H})$ be the Seidel matrix of a hypergraph $\mathcal{H}$, and the Seidel energy is denoted by the sum of the absolute eigenvalues of $\mathcal{S}(\mathcal{H})$. In [G.~X.~Tian, Y.~Li and S.~Y.~Cui, The change of Seidel energy of tripartite Turán graph due to edge deletion, Linear Multilinear Algebra, 19 (2022), 4597-4614] and [Y.~Liu, X.~Chen, The change of Seidel energy of 5-partite Turán graph due to edge deletion, Discrete Applied Mathematics, 2024, 342, 104-123], the authors studied the change of Seidel energy of the Turán graph due to edge deletion.
